description: 第三方审计预演包契约。该预演包消费 current audit bundle、audit dry-run、current release proof、measurement infrastructure certification、external validation closure evidence summary、tracker import package、tracker issue evidence template 和 tracker issue evidence gate，输出给独立审计人员复核的证据索引、阻断项、外部待验证项和审计检查清单。它不执行真实外部请求，不替代真实第三方审计，不把 blocked/pending 证据伪装成通过。

requiredInputs.current-audit-bundle.json: 当前 commit 审计证据包。
requiredInputs.audit-dry-run.json: 审计 handoff dry-run 结果。
requiredInputs.current-release-proof.json: 当前发布证据聚合结果；本地 quick 模式可保持 blocked。
requiredInputs.measurement-infrastructure-certification: 100% 测算基础设施 certification dry-run 聚合结果。
requiredInputs.external-validation-closure-evidence-sum: 外部验证关闭证据摘要。
requiredInputs.external-validation-tracker-import-packa: 外部验证 tracker import package，列出待人工创建的脱敏 issue body、命令文本和 package gate。
requiredInputs.external-validation-tracker-issue-eviden: 外部验证 tracker issue evidence bundle 模板，列出 operator 需填写的脱敏 issue ref/hash 字段。
外部验证 tracker issue 创建证据门禁，记录 tracker issue evidence 是否结构接受。

rehearsalGatePolicy.status: blocked until all required evidence gates are passed, all external pending items are closed, and an independent auditor result is attached outside this local rehearsal.
rehearsalGatePolicy.localReadiness: status=passed only means the rehearsal package was generated and all input files are structurally consumable.
rehearsalGatePolicy.thirdPartyAudit: A human or external auditor must review the package and provide a separate signed/traceable result.

privacyBoundary: 输出只保存证据文件路径、gate 状态、计数、category、owner、runbook/operator step 标识和凭证变量名；不得复制真实 URL、token、secret、DSN、webhook secret、报告正文、用户输入、生产日志或第三方账号数据。
nonClaims: Does not execute production API, HF Space, Telegram Bot, Postgres, OTel, IdP, SIEM, Vault/KMS, developer portal or sandbox live checks.
Does not prove production live, external connectivity, legal license review, OIDC/SIEM completion, or 100% measurement infrastructure readiness.
Does not attach a signed external auditor result.
releaseBoundary: status=passed 只表示预演包结构生成成功；rehearsalGate.status=passed 只能在所有输入证据通过、externalPending 为空且独立第三方审计结果已另行附加时出现。本地 quick CI 默认应保持 blocked。
